texts.preamble: Mohammad Rizwan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 January, 2025 Author: Sanjay Dwivedi Bench: Sanjay Dwivedi 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur Mcrc No. 39589 of 2024 (Mohammad Rizwan Vs The State Of Madhya Prade Dated : 15-01-2025 Shri Priyank Khandelwal - Advocate for the petitioner. Shri K.V.S. Sunil Rao - Panel Lawyer for the respondent
texts.arguments: The petitioner is seeking quashing of FIR on the ground that he has already punished under the provisions of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and, therefore, he cannot be prosecuted under the provisions of Indian Penal Code. Learned counsel for the petitioner, in support of his stand, has placed reliance upon a judgment reported in (2024) 3 SCC 502 [Ram Nath vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh and ors.]. Learned counsel for the respondent/State is directed to examine this aspect and address the Court because on this legal point. Although, learned counsel for the petitioner is seeking interim protection saying that the Court is likely to frame the charge against the petitioner, but it does not make any difference, if prosecution would be done under the provisions of IPC, then under the developed circumstances, the charges, if any, is framed by the Court can also be [LEAKAGE_MASK] by this Court.
